meta.title: SAP MDG (Master Data Governance): on failure — retry 3x with exponential backoff
gaps: Configure the SAP MDG integration and its tenant configuration dependencies.
Make the SAP MDG external endpoint fail or become unreachable.
Create or update a vendor in Procol to trigger synchronization.
Observe and verify exactly three retries with exponential backoff using integration state, alerts, logs, or retry records.
Verify that the vendor change is not silently dropped.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the SAP MDG integration and its tenant configuration dependencies.; Make the SAP MDG external endpoint fail or become unreachable.; Create or update a vendor in Procol to trigger synchronization.; Observe and verify exactly three retries with exponential backoff using integration state, alerts, logs, or retry records.; Verify that the vendor change is not silently dropped.

args.need: configure SAP MDG, make its external endpoint fail, create or update a vendor to trigger synchronization, and verify evidence of exactly three retries with exponential backoff and no silently dropped change

steps.note: These integration setup, failure-injection, vendor-trigger, and retry-evidence actions cannot be performed or observed by catalog steps.
Assert that the session has no visible crash or generic server error after the tester-executed workflow; this does not verify the retry behavior.
